title: System settings
subtitle: Manage shared website branding, information and time zone.
descriptionHint: Used in page information and search results, up to 300 characters.
timezoneHint: Choose a time zone by location. UTC offsets reflect the current date and may change with daylight saving time. Used for statistics and activity history.
imageHint: Images up to 5 MB. Upload a file or paste an http(s) URL or a path starting with /.
logoUrlHint: Shown in the navigation brand area.
iconUrlHint: Used in collapsed navigation and the admin sign-in icon.
faviconUrlHint: The browser tab icon. A square PNG or ICO is recommended.
loadError: Could not load system settings. Please try again.
saveError: Could not save settings. Check the values and try again.
uploadError: Could not upload the image. Choose an image up to 5 MB and try again.
invalidTimezone: Invalid time zone. Choose a time zone from the list.
applyHint: The learner website and admin share these settings. Reload to receive new settings immediately; blank images use the default icon.
previewError: Could not display the image. Check the URL or choose another file.
timezoneSearch: Search by city, time zone name or UTC...
timezoneNoMatches: No other matching time zones. The current time zone is retained.

landing.title: Landing page
landing.subtitle: Images shown on the introduction page that signed-out visitors see when they open the learner website.
landing.heroImageUrlHint: Shown to the right of the page headline.
landing.toeicImageUrlHint: Illustration for the TOEIC practice section.
landing.gamesImageUrlHint: Cover image of the vocabulary games card.
landing.arenaImageUrlHint: Cover image of the vocabulary arena card.
landing.dropHint: Click to upload or drag and drop
landing.fileHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP, SVG – up to 5 MB
landing.saved: Saved. The landing page will use the new images on its next load.
landing.loadError: Could not load the landing page settings. Please try again.
landing.saveError: Could not save. Check the image URLs and try again.
landing.invalidUrl: The URL must start with http(s):// or /.
landing.imagesGroupHint: Empty slots use the built-in illustrations. Up to 5 MB per image.
